topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The office is quieter now, the kind of quiet that echoes in the halls. He’s gone, moved to a different department, and it feels as though a shadow has settled where his laughter used to fill the air. The space he left behind is more than just a desk; it’s a reminder of the days we shared, the projects we tackled side by side. I find myself reaching out to ask him a question, only to pull back, remembering too late that he won’t be there to offer his usual insights. The team carries on, as it must, but the papers on my desk seem a little less bright, the tasks a bit more daunting. I suppose I’ll adjust, as one always does, but for now, the silence sits heavily, unspoken but deeply felt.
